# 15Five | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning in one sentence | A platform for performance, participation, manager effectiveness and retention. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | does not replace core HRIS and local pay; managers use rates to determine value; AI generation content, performance ratings and sensitive person data need to be regulated. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | There is no substitute for the core HRIS and local pay; managers use rates to determine value; AI generation content, performance ratings and sensitive personnel data need to be addressed. |
